title: GRANULAR -- multichannel granular synth for files or live input

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Load File: pick a sound file (it replaces the buffer, shown in the BUFFER display).
Live Input: records adc 1 into the buffer in a continuous loop instead.
DSP: turns audio on. Raise the OUTPUT fader -- it starts at 0 (silent) on open.
GRAIN: Size (10-500 ms), Density (1-100 grains/s), Position (0-1 in the buffer), Pitch.
Pitch is a playback rate from 0.25x to 4x; 1.0x sits at the centre of the dial.
ENVELOPE Shape: 0 = Hann window, 1 = triangle, blends in between.
SCATTER: Pos Jit, Pitch Jit and Size Jit randomise each grain around the GRAIN settings.
SPACE: Pan sets the centre, Spread the random width, Spkrs the speaker count (2-8).

sections.heading: INPUTS & OUTPUTS
lines: Input: adc~ channel 1 (only while Live Input is on).
Output: mc.dac~ on channels 1-8; only the first Spkrs channels carry sound (stereo = 1-2).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: gen~ granular-sched owns every parameter and schedules grains onto 32 voices.
Each grain's start, pitch, size and pan are fixed when it starts, so dial moves never click.
mc.gen~ granular-voice plays one grain per channel from buffer~ granular_buf.
mc.mixdown~ pans each grain across the active speakers; gain~ sets the final level.
